# Sample size calculation for two independent normal means
# One-sided pooled t-test, α = 0.05, target power = 0.80
# Effect size: δ = 4.3 dBA, σ = 7.8 dBA, allocation ratio 1:1

library(stats)

# Parameters
delta <- 4.3      # expected difference (dBA)
sigma <- 7.8      # common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05     # significance level
power_target <- 0.80  # target power
ratio <- 1        # allocation ratio (1:1)

# Standardized effect size
cohens_d <- delta / sigma

# Critical value for one-sided test at α = 0.05
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha)

# Critical value for two-sided test at corresponding α for power calculation
# For one-sided test with target power, we use the one-sided quantile
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)

# Sample size formula for two independent samples (unequal variances general form)
# For equal variances and 1:1 allocation:
# n = 2 * (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * σ^2 / δ^2
# Equivalently: n = 2 * (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 / d^2 where d = δ/σ

n_continuous <- 2 * (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 / (cohens_d^2)

cat("=== Two-Sample t-test Sample Size Calculation ===\n\n")
cat("Study Design Parameters:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Expected difference (δ):     %.1f dBA\n", delta))
cat(sprintf("  Common SD (σ):                %.1f dBA\n", sigma))
cat(sprintf("  Standardized effect size:     %.4f\n", cohens_d))
cat(sprintf("  Significance level (α):       %.2f (one-sided)\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("  Target power:                 %.2f\n", power_target))
cat(sprintf("  Allocation ratio:             %d:%d\n", ratio, ratio))
cat("\nCritical values:\n")
cat(sprintf("  z_α (one-sided):              %.4f\n", z_alpha))
cat(sprintf("  z_β (power):                  %.4f\n", z_beta))
cat(sprintf("  z_α + z_β:                    %.4f\n", z_alpha + z_beta))

cat("\nSample size calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("  n (continuous) = 2 * (%.4f)^2 / (%.4f)^2\n", z_alpha + z_beta, cohens_d))
cat(sprintf("  n (continuous) = %.4f per group\n", n_continuous))

# Round up to next integer
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat(sprintf("\n  n (rounded up) = %d per group\n", n_integer))

# Verify power at selected sample size
# For t-test, use non-centrality parameter and t-distribution
# Non-centrality parameter: λ = δ / SE
# SE = σ * sqrt(2/n) for two equal-sized groups
SE_selected <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n_integer)
ncp_selected <- delta / SE_selected
df_selected <- 2 * n_integer - 2

# Critical value from t-distribution
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df_selected)

# Power calculation via non-central t distribution
power_achieved <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df_selected, ncp = ncp_selected)

cat("\n=== Verification at Selected Sample Size ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Sample size per group:        %d\n", n_integer))
cat(sprintf("Total sample size:            %d\n", 2 * n_integer))
cat(sprintf("Degrees of freedom:           %d\n", df_selected))
cat(sprintf("Standard error:               %.4f dBA\n", SE_selected))
cat(sprintf("Non-centrality parameter:     %.4f\n", ncp_selected))
cat(sprintf("t-critical value (α=0.05):    %.4f\n", t_crit))
cat(sprintf("Achieved power:               %.4f\n", power_achieved))

# Check power at n-1 (preceding design)
n_prev <- n_integer - 1
if (n_prev > 1) {
  SE_prev <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n_prev)
  ncp_prev <- delta / SE_prev
  df_prev <- 2 * n_prev - 2
  t_crit_prev <- qt(1 - alpha, df_prev)
  power_prev <- 1 - pt(t_crit_prev, df_prev, ncp = ncp_prev)
  
  cat("\n=== Verification at Previous Sample Size ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Sample size per group:        %d\n", n_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Degrees of freedom:           %d\n", df_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Standard error:               %.4f dBA\n", SE_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Non-centrality parameter:     %.4f\n", ncp_prev))
  cat(sprintf("t-critical value (α=0.05):    %.4f\n", t_crit_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Achieved power:               %.4f\n", power_prev))
}

# Return results as JSON
results <- list(
  list(
    metric = "sample_size",
    value = n_integer,
    unit = "participants_per_group"
  ),
  list(
    metric = "achieved_power",
    value = round(power_achieved, 6),
    unit = "probability"
  ),
  list(
    metric = "achieved_power_n_minus_1",
    value = round(power_prev, 6),
    unit = "probability"
  ),
  list(
    metric = "standardized_effect_size",
    value = round(cohens_d, 4),
    unit = "Cohen_d"
  )
)

cat("\n=== JSON Output ===\n")
cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = results), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Function to compute power at a given sample size per group
compute_power_exact <- function(n, delta, sigma, alpha) {
  # Standard error for two equal groups
  SE <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n)
  
  # Non-centrality parameter
  ncp <- delta / SE
  
  # Degrees of freedom
  df <- 2 * n - 2
  
  # Critical value from t-distribution (one-sided, upper tail)
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
  
  # Power: P(T > t_crit | H1) where T ~ t(df, ncp)
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
  
  return(power)
}

# Sample size calculation for two independent normal means
# One-sided pooled t-test, α = 0.05, target power = 0.80
# Effect size: δ = 4.3 dBA, σ = 7.8 dBA, allocation ratio 1:1

library(stats)

# Parameters
delta <- 4.3      # expected difference (dBA)
sigma <- 7.8      # common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05     # significance level
power_target <- 0.80  # target power
ratio <- 1        # allocation ratio (1:1)

# Standardized effect size
cohens_d <- delta / sigma

# Critical value for one-sided test at α = 0.05
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha)

# Critical value for two-sided test at corresponding α for power calculation
# For one-sided test with target power, we use the one-sided quantile
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)

# Sample size formula for two independent samples (unequal variances general form)
# For equal variances and 1:1 allocation:
# n = 2 * (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * σ^2 / δ^2
# Equivalently: n = 2 * (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 / d^2 where d = δ/σ

n_continuous <- 2 * (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 / (cohens_d^2)

cat("=== Two-Sample t-test Sample Size Calculation ===\n\n")
cat("Study Design Parameters:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Expected difference (δ):     %.1f dBA\n", delta))
cat(sprintf("  Common SD (σ):                %.1f dBA\n", sigma))
cat(sprintf("  Standardized effect size:     %.4f\n", cohens_d))
cat(sprintf("  Significance level (α):       %.2f (one-sided)\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("  Target power:                 %.2f\n", power_target))
cat(sprintf("  Allocation ratio:             %d:%d\n", ratio, ratio))
cat("\nCritical values:\n")
cat(sprintf("  z_α (one-sided):              %.4f\n", z_alpha))
cat(sprintf("  z_β (power):                  %.4f\n", z_beta))
cat(sprintf("  z_α + z_β:                    %.4f\n", z_alpha + z_beta))

cat("\nSample size calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("  n (continuous) = 2 * (%.4f)^2 / (%.4f)^2\n", z_alpha + z_beta, cohens_d))
cat(sprintf("  n (continuous) = %.4f per group\n", n_continuous))

# Round up to next integer
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat(sprintf("\n  n (rounded up) = %d per group\n", n_integer))

# Verify power at selected sample size
# For t-test, use non-centrality parameter and t-distribution
# Non-centrality parameter: λ = δ / SE
# SE = σ * sqrt(2/n) for two equal-sized groups
SE_selected <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n_integer)
ncp_selected <- delta / SE_selected
df_selected <- 2 * n_integer - 2

# Critical value from t-distribution
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df_selected)

# Power calculation via non-central t distribution
power_achieved <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df_selected, ncp = ncp_selected)

cat("\n=== Verification at Selected Sample Size ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Sample size per group:        %d\n", n_integer))
cat(sprintf("Total sample size:            %d\n", 2 * n_integer))
cat(sprintf("Degrees of freedom:           %d\n", df_selected))
cat(sprintf("Standard error:               %.4f dBA\n", SE_selected))
cat(sprintf("Non-centrality parameter:     %.4f\n", ncp_selected))
cat(sprintf("t-critical value (α=0.05):    %.4f\n", t_crit))
cat(sprintf("Achieved power:               %.4f\n", power_achieved))

# Check power at n-1 (preceding design)
n_prev <- n_integer - 1
if (n_prev > 1) {
  SE_prev <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n_prev)
  ncp_prev <- delta / SE_prev
  df_prev <- 2 * n_prev - 2
  t_crit_prev <- qt(1 - alpha, df_prev)
  power_prev <- 1 - pt(t_crit_prev, df_prev, ncp = ncp_prev)
  
  cat("\n=== Verification at Previous Sample Size ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Sample size per group:        %d\n", n_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Degrees of freedom:           %d\n", df_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Standard error:               %.4f dBA\n", SE_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Non-centrality parameter:     %.4f\n", ncp_prev))
  cat(sprintf("t-critical value (α=0.05):    %.4f\n", t_crit_prev))
  cat(sprintf("Achieved power:               %.4f\n", power_prev))
}

# Return results as JSON
results <- list(
  list(
    metric = "sample_size",
    value = n_integer,
    unit = "participants_per_group"
  ),
  list(
    metric = "achieved_power",
    value = round(power_achieved, 6),
    unit = "probability"
  ),
  list(
    metric = "achieved_power_n_minus_1",
    value = round(power_prev, 6),
    unit = "probability"
  ),
  list(
    metric = "standardized_effect_size",
    value = round(cohens_d, 4),
    unit = "Cohen_d"
  )
)

cat("\n=== JSON Output ===\n")
cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = results), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# One-sided pooled t-test, α = 0.05, target power = 0.80
# Using exact non-central t-distribution (not normal approximation)

# Parameters
delta <- 4.3      # expected difference (dBA)
sigma <- 7.8      # common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05     # significance level
power_target <- 0.80  # target power
ratio <- 1        # allocation ratio (1:1)

# Function to compute power at a given sample size per group
compute_power_exact <- function(n, delta, sigma, alpha) {
  # Standard error for two equal groups
  SE <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n)
  
  # Non-centrality parameter
  ncp <- delta / SE
  
  # Degrees of freedom
  df <- 2 * n - 2
  
  # Critical value from t-distribution (one-sided, upper tail)
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
  
  # Power: P(T > t_crit | H1) where T ~ t(df, ncp)
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
  
  return(power)
}

# Search for minimum sample size meeting target power
# Start with a reasonable initial guess
n_test <- 30
found <- FALSE
minimum_n <- NA

# Binary search is more efficient, but let's use simple iteration for clarity
for (n in 30:100) {
  power <- compute_power_exact(n, delta, sigma, alpha)
  
  cat(sprintf("n = %d: power = %.6f\n", n, power))
  
  if (power >= power_target && !found) {
    minimum_n <- n
    found <- TRUE
    cat(sprintf("\n*** First n meeting target power: %d (power = %.6f) ***\n\n", minimum_n, power))
    break

}

  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
  
  # Power: P(T > t_crit | H1) where T ~ t(df, ncp)
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
  
  return(power)
